headline: BRICS Summit bilateral talks end abruptly after delegates realize they were just comparing notes on which air-fryer settings produce the crispest samosas
body:
"I honestly thought the secret document they were passing around was a new trade agreement, but it turned out to be a PDF printout of an air-fryer manual with annotations on how to get the perfect golden-brown crunch," says a local office clerk who was catering the summit snacks.

"The head of delegation looked me straight in the eye and asked if I preferred the convection setting or the high-heat blast for frozen snacks, and suddenly the entire geopolitical tension in the room just evaporated into a friendly debate about pre-heating times," notes a protocol intern tasked with taking meeting minutes.

"I was waiting outside to report on major economic shifts, but the only 'major shift' I saw was two world leaders frantically swapping Amazon affiliate links for kitchen gadgets they found on sale," mentions a veteran political reporter waiting for a press briefing.

"It’s refreshing, honestly, because if global leaders can finally agree that the secret to the perfect evening snack is a light mist of mustard oil before frying, maybe there is hope for a unified global culinary policy after all," adds a neighbourhood tea-stall owner near the summit venue.
caption: From high-stakes diplomacy to high-heat frying, the real summit breakthrough was culinary. #BRICS2026 #AirFryerDiplomacy #SamosaSummit #Geopolitics (satire)
igHook: Tag the friend who treats their air-fryer like a holy relic.
